steps.title: Define Smart Notes Application Structure
steps.description: Configure system folders and project namespaces for the Smart Notes app.

steps.title: Create AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Register MainActivity and application definitions in compliance with Android SDK 34 specifications under package com.smartnotes.app.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle and Environment Properties
steps.description: Configure target compile level, minimum SDK, target SDK configurations, and build-time Java 8 targets.

steps.title: Implement DatabaseHelper.java for Local SQLite Storage
steps.description: Develop the SQLite open helper to manage note creation, update, query filter, and delete actions locally.

steps.title: Implement Note.java Data Class
steps.description: Create the foundational Java object definition mapping note attributes including unique identifier, title, content, category, and timestamps.

steps.title: Design list_note_item.xml Layout
steps.description: Design the UI template representation for single list entries including titles, dynamic category background badges, textual contents, and edit/delete interactions.

steps.title: Implement NoteAdapter.java Class
steps.description: Create a robust custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to efficiently populate the UI ListView with local records.

steps.title: Design activity_main.xml Interface Layout
steps.description: Implement split dual-panel container structure in the activity layout supporting instant toggling between listing dashboard and full editor panels.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java Lifecycle Hooks
steps.description: Initialize native layouts, standard spinners, SQLite database resources, adapters, list references, and editor UI triggers inside onCreate lifecycle callbacks.

steps.title: Integrate Search Filter TextWatcher Listeners
steps.description: Hook standard TextWatcher classes dynamically to support live SQL text filtering upon every keystroke.

steps.title: Integrate Category Filtering Spinners
steps.description: Hook OnItemSelectedListener objects on custom Spinners to dynamically filter active listings based on designated categories.

steps.title: Implement Note Creation Operations
steps.description: Provide seamless editor view transitions that clear text fields, set defaults, and trigger software input keyboard handlers for writing new notes.

steps.title: Implement Note Update Editing Capabilities
steps.description: Populate existing note records into target active text inputs inside full-view editor layouts to facilitate edits.

steps.title: Implement Note Deletion Workflows
steps.description: Incorporate dialog confirmations to verify user actions before purging active database records.

steps.title: Verify Code Compatibility & Java 8 Syntax
steps.description: Audit application sources to guarantee compliance with Java 8 specifications and verify overall layout namespace properties.

steps.title: Building Smart Notes
steps.description: Compile, package, and build the APK release file for Smart Notes.
